note: Extension fields for fantasy characters, added on top of the base `character.md` schema. Machine source: `00 Meta/FileClasses/fc-character-fantasy.md`, which `extends: fc-character`. Apply this FileClass to characters that need species/combat/magic facts; otherwise the base character schema is enough.

fields.name: species
fields.description: Select — e.g. `Human | HighElf | DarkElf | WoodElf | Dwarf | Halfling | Orc | Ogre | Beastfolk | Catfolk | Merfolk | Fae | Pixie | Dragonkin | Demon | Undead | Mystical | Other`. The character's species/ancestry.

fields.name: combat_skills
fields.description: List. Combat abilities, drawn from the value list in `00 Meta/FileClasses/fc-combat-skills.md`.

fields.name: other_skills
fields.description: Text. Non-combat, non-magical skills worth tracking.

fields.name: weapons
fields.description: List of text. Weapons the character characteristically carries.

fields.name: magical_items
fields.description: Text. Notable magical items carried (for canonical objects, prefer a `[[wikilink]]` to an object note under `30 Canon/33 Objects/`).
